statement: Elon Musk says SpaceXAI will add another 660,000 GB300 GPUs in three roughly 220,000-unit waves in Q4 2026, taking total GPUs in operation across Colossus 1 and Colossus 2 to about 1.44 million.
why: A single buyer absorbing hundreds of thousands of top-end GPUs in one quarter concentrates a large share of merchant-GPU demand in one account.

impact.mechanism: Deployment at this scale by one customer sustains near-term accelerator, memory and fabric demand, while making the demand picture dependent on that customer continuing to buy.

evidence.excerpt: Another 220k GB300 will be fully operational next week and another 220k in November. If we get lucky, yet another 220k GB300 by late December.
would bring SpaceXAI's GB300 total to 1.1 million units and total GPUs in operation across both sites to approximately 1.44 million

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of a social-media post by the company's owner; the third 220k wave is explicitly conditional ('if we get lucky') and the article body was not retrievable.

dispersion: Two waves stated as scheduled (next week, November) and a third conditional on luck by late December.
entity: xAI / SpaceXAI (Colossus 1 and Colossus 2 data centers)
